title: Shipping Log - Week 27 - POTUS talks to our avatar
summary: Here's what happened in Week 27: 1) The President of the United States talked to our avatar! 2) Our AI Teddy Roosevelt avatar, built in collaboration with Microsoft, launched to the world. 3) We made it easy to know when your avatar is ready.
body_markdown:
Hi guys,


What a week! Here are some of the highlights:


1. **The President of the United States talked to our avatar!** This was wild. President Trump was supposed to talk to AI Teddy Roosevelt for 1 minute, but ended up talking to it for nearly 15 minutes.[Here's a clip](https://x.com/MargoMartin47/status/2072393375244804320) .


2. **Our AI Teddy Roosevelt avatar, built in collaboration with Microsoft, launched to the world** . This was part of America's 250th birthday celebration. Brad Smith, President of Microsoft, said to me during his visit, “\[The avatar\] you created is amazing. It *is* state of the art. It has been such a pleasure for us at Microsoft to work with LemonSlice.” See coverage in[Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/lesliekatz/2026/07/01/ai-powered-theodore-roosevelt-is-ready-to-answer-your-questions/) ,[Gizmodo](https://gizmodo.com/president-trump-chats-with-ai-teddy-roosevelt-about-the-panama-canal-2000780299) ,[CNET](https://www.cnet.com/tech/services-and-software/teddy-roosevelt-ai-avatar-donald-trump-interaction/) , and more.


3. **We made it easy to know when your avatar is ready** . We shipped an npm package that tells you the exact moment an avatar is ready to join your video call. This is something several folks had asked for. Check it out[here](https://github.com/lemonsliceai/avatar-js#) .


4. **Join our ElevenLabs-LemonSlice webinar next week** . We'll show you exactly how to add a face to your ElevenLabs voice agents. It's on Wed July 15 at 10a PT.[Register here](https://app.sequel.io/elevenlabs/lemonsliceavatars) .


- Lina


PS - Join our[LemonSlice Community Slack](https://join.slack.com/t/lemonslicecommunity/shared_invite/zt-3zm2s6z06-72ckFaS04JhLMy8eHm_OwA) and ask any avatar questions you might have… or just say hello!
